about: Three runs over one system prompt, which is stored once. A failed run with an erroring call, a run longer than an hour, and a run still in flight: no end, no duration, a call with no result, and a system prompt the harness didn't keep. What each changed: the first three files over three commits, one of them its turn's (a path counts once however many commits touch it); the failed run nothing; the run in flight never landed, so it is not known.
